independence_evidence: Published by Circle08 Media Ltd ('© 2026 Circle08 Media Ltd'), a small company set up for this title by a former British GQ Style editor; the about page describes it as a founder-led multimedia platform and biannual publication, with no media-group owner.
qualifies_reason: Independent UK biannual with Issue 09 (2026) on sale in its own store and nine print issues since 2021.
what_it_is: CircleZeroEight is a UK magazine about sport seen through style and culture: profiles of footballers, fighters and athletes shot like fashion editorials, features on grassroots clubs and sporting subcultures, and fashion stories tied to the rituals of the game. Each biannual issue comes with several covers (Issue 09, a football issue timed to the 2026 World Cup, has Morgan Rogers, Khadija Shaw and a 'We Are The World' cover). It suits readers who follow sport but buy fashion and culture glossies.
